title: Nilikuta Mario Kart kwenye arcade ya SM Clark
label: Arcade ya Mall

text.The SM mall in the Philippines had an ar: Mall ya SM nchini Ufilipino ilikuwa na arcade.
text.Compared to arcades in Japanese shopping: Ukilinganisha na arcade katika maduka makubwa ya Japani, arcade nzima ilihisi zaidi kama neon, na ilikuwa na mandhari ya taa za zambarau.
text.Also, inside the arcade, there were abou: Pia, ndani ya arcade, kulikuwa na vibanda vya karaoke takriban 5, vya ukubwa wa watu 2 hivi, na uliweza kuona moja kwa moja ndani yake kutoka nje.
text.Of course, there were also some Japanese: Bila shaka, kulikuwa pia na baadhi ya michezo ya Kijapani.
text.They had a game where you shoot basketba: Walikuwa na mchezo wa kurusha mipira ya kikapu, mchezo wa Kijapani wa sarafu wa kuvua samaki, na mchezo wa zombi kama Resident Evil.
text.And they also had Mario Kart!: Na pia walikuwa na Mario Kart!
text.Someone I knew in Clark often drove me t: Mtu niliyemjua huko Clark mara nyingi alinipeleka kwa gari hadi Koreatown huko Angeles
